title: Staying Active: Three Stories
shared_passage: Listen to three people talk about their experiences with fitness and exercise, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: What does Rebecca think about joining a gym?
options: It doesn't provide enough variety for her.

questions.question: What is Rebecca's advice about friends and exercise?
options: Make friends with people who like exercise.
Encourage your friends to exercise with you.
Don't be embarrassed about exercising alone.

questions.question: What caused Jeff to start exercising?
Since exercising more regularly, Jeff has…
options: included exercise in his everyday routine.

questions.question: As a young man, Leo kept fit because…
options: he was always worried about his health.
he was a member of various sports teams.
he had a generally active lifestyle.

questions.question: Leo has found that exercising with other people has…
options: had little impact on his fitness level.
introduced him to several new sports.
enabled him to return to his past fitness level.
